effect_sizes_observed.metric_definition: Corpus-level WER reduction (oracle-8 best-of-N minus greedy decode), single condition SNR=5 only. Paired bootstrap 95% CI over utterances.
effect_sizes_observed.note_excerpt: Corpus-WER effect is +0.0296, CI [0.0212, 0.0390] — SNR=5 only, a single condition; do not generalize to clean/other SNRs without a fresh run. A macro (per-utterance-averaged) figure of +0.0418 also exists in prior write-ups; it MUST be labeled "macro utterance-WER" wherever quoted and never presented as the unqualified/primary WER figure (G4 gate).

effect_sizes_observed.note_excerpt: Corpus-level delta is -0.0012, CI crosses 0 — indistinguishable from no effect; MUST NOT be cited as a positive result. A separate review reports N=1/2 (of the disaggregated cells) as significantly WORSE than greedy; that finding is pending re-verification and is not yet folded into this status.

effect_sizes_observed.metric_definition: Across-seed paired t-CI on the dev-selected pooling delta, five dependent runs (not independent replicates — same cohort/task reused across "seeds").
effect_sizes_observed.note_excerpt: Five DEPENDENT runs; the t-CI spans 0. Because the five runs are dependent (share cohort/setup), they carry no independent-replication meaning beyond a single run's worth of evidence — do not describe this as "5x replicated" anywhere.

effect_sizes_observed.metric_definition: Linear-probe accuracy for speaker identity from the frozen embedding vs. chance baseline (chance = 1/n_speakers ~= 0.011).
effect_sizes_observed.note_excerpt: "No speaker info" is NOT established: the probe reaches 0.0333 accuracy vs. a chance baseline of 0.011 (~3x chance). The seed-123 arm's CI excludes chance ABOVE it (i.e., significantly above chance — the opposite direction from the claim). No formal equivalence-to-chance test (e.g. TOST) has ever been run, so the claim is neither confirmed nor refuted by a proper test — it is unverified, and the raw numbers argue against it if anything.
